resources.string: This update has to be installed by hand

The new version is published under a different app identity (%1$s, where this one is %2$s). Your phone treats that as a separate app rather than an update, and will not install it on top of this one. Nothing is broken and the download is fine — Android just does not allow this change in place.
We cannot confirm from here that this really is the same project under a new name. If you did not expect this app to be renamed, do not install it — report what you see on this screen first.
Your words and your settings will NOT move across on their own. Uninstalling deletes them. Do step 1 first, or they are gone.
1. Save everything to a file first — “%1$s”, higher up on this page.
2. Get the new version using one of the buttons below.
3. Uninstall this app.
4. Open the file you downloaded and install it.
5. Open the new app and use “%1$s” to bring your words and settings back.
Open the download page
Copy the download link

Nothing on this phone can open a link. Use “%1$s” instead and paste it somewhere you can download from.
This version is not downloaded automatically, because it cannot be installed over the app you have.
The file we downloaded matches the published fingerprint exactly, so this is not a broken download and downloading it again will not help.
Your phone refused this because the new version is published under a different app identity — to Android that is a separate app, not an update.

Your phone refused this: the file is not signed with the same key as the app you already have. Do not uninstall to force it through — that erases every word this keyboard learned from you. Please report this screen instead.
Your phone already has a newer version than this one, and Android never installs backwards. There is nothing for you to do here — this is a mistake on our side. Please report it.
There is not enough free space to install this. It needs about %1$s free, plus room to unpack. Clear some space and press Install again.

This build does not fit this phone — either it was built for a different kind of chip, or your Android version is older than it needs. Nothing you do on the phone will change that. Please report which phone and Android version you have.

Your phone blocked the install. Phones with Play Protect scanning switched on sometimes block apps that did not come from the store: try again and choose the option to install anyway, or turn that scanning off for a moment.
Install cancelled. Nothing on your phone changed. Press Install again whenever you are ready.
Your phone refused to install this file and did not say why in a way we recognise. Please report the message below — it is the only clue there is.
